Tara - CSM: Heads up — GreenWave Labs (team: insight-sandbox) just reported a big jump in notebook usage. DS folks say iteration is painfully slow. Link: https://app.redwood.dev/customers/greenwave/usage :eyes:
Alex - SE: Can you share the 48h summary and which endpoints/models they hit most?
Tara - CSM: Pasted from Console:
```
48h peak qps: 920
baseline qps: 280
median tokens/req: 450
95th tokens/req: 1200
routes: /chat (70%), /embed (20%), /rerank (10%)
errors: ~3% 429s on /chat during peaks, occasional 504s
p95 latency (/chat) at peak: 2.1s, tail up to 5s
```
Ben - AE: Renewal ~4 months out. This looks like an expansion / upsell opportunity if we can make the notebook experience smooth. They mentioned cost concerns but will pay for predictable latency for internal prototypes.
Maya - Infra: 429s are likely hitting concurrency limits on the chat route and/or queue timeouts. We can offer a short-term dedicated pilot or a prewarmed pool. Need expected sustained qps for the pilot window and any compliance/VPC needs.
Tara - CSM: They also requested per-route token breakdown in Console CSV export so finance can do chargebacks. Feature ask logged.
Alex - SE: Models? If they're using long-context variants we can recommend a trimmed quantized variant for notebook experiments and advise on smaller batch windows to reduce tail latency.
Tara - CSM: Primary models: redwood/longform-16k and redwood/fast-chat-8k. Some teams are experimenting with embeddings-heavy pipelines for retrieval-augmented workflows.
ops-bot: trial_pool_request created by Tara for customer=greenwave, pool=dedicated-trial-45d, requested_gpus=2, burst_to=4
Ben - AE: Proposed approach: 45-day dedicated pilot (2 GPUs, autoscale to 4 for bursts) with clear success metrics: sustained qps >=700, P95 < 1s for /chat, <1% 429s. If achieved, pursue reserved capacity + billback integration.
Maya - Infra: I can provision a trial pool tonight and attach dashboards. I'll add alerts: 429 rate >1%, queue wait >200ms. Also can enable prefix KV caching for repeated notebook prompts. Any SLOs for embeddings route?
Tara - CSM: Customer wants embeddings latency under 500ms for interactive vector search. I'll confirm whether they need VPC/KMS. Also scheduling kickoff: Thu 2pm PT works for them.
Alex - SE: I'll draft a lightweight playbook for notebook users: suggested quantization flags, `batch.max_tokens`, `session_kv=true`, and a tiny Colab/Notebook repro. Will include CLI commands to reproduce load patterns.
Ben - AE: I'll update CRM: "GreenWave — expansion intent: notebook/DS sandbox -> dedicated pilot (45d)" and note renewal. I'll prep a pricing summary comparing Hosted vs Dedicated unit costs.
Tara - CSM: Action list: 
- Tara: Kickoff Thu 2pm PT with GreenWave leads, collect security checklist
- Maya: Provision 2-GPU trial pool + autoscale to 4, attach dashboards/alerts
- Alex: Playbook + repro notebook before kickoff
- Ben: CRM update + pricing comparison + renewal tag
- All: Capture qualitative DS feedback and measure success metrics on shared dashboard

Maya - Infra: No infra blockers. Will provision and post dashboard links here once ready.
Tara - CSM: Great — tagging this thread in the ticket. Will report back after kickoff with initial numbers and DS feedback. :thumbsup:
